description: Openverse openly licensed image search (Creative Commons and public domain): title, creator, license, ready-made attribution, source page, direct image URL and size. Images only; each result keeps its own license. Results can be slow (up to ~15 s). Related tools on this server, for a different need: media_loom_video_downloader when you need public metadata for a Loom video from Loom's oEmbed API; media_podchaser when you need Podcast search across the Apple Podcasts directory: podcast. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.
